title: Theory of Incidence — A Fourth Foundation
description: A Lean 4 formalization of incidence structures as a foundational framework for mathematics and computation. The checked development includes bisimulation and faithfulness, concrete consistency models, translation preservation and reflection, propositional internal-logic soundness and completeness, dependent Pi/Sigma/Identity syntax and semantics, total normalized renaming and substitution preservation, and reconstructions of Peano naturals, hereditary finite sets, pairs, trees, paths, simplices, products, sums, and conditional quotients.
